sources.cite: Amazon Route 53 Developer Guide, What is Amazon Route 53 Resolver?
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 'Inbound Resolver endpoints allow DNS queries to your VPC from your on-premises network or another VPC'; 'Outbound Resolver endpoints allow DNS queries from your VPC to your on-premises network'; 'The on-premises DNS resolver has a forwarding rule that points queries to dev.example.com to an inbound endpoint'; VPC Resolver answers records in private hosted zones. The Route 53 page 'Considerations when creating inbound and outbound endpoints' (read 2026-11-18): 'For each Resolver endpoint, you specify two or more IP addresses in different Availability Zones', and to resolve inbound queries from a private hosted zone, 'associate the private hosted zone with the VPC that you created the inbound endpoint in'.
